name: Nordreth Works 37 EGEO
description: Key Features High-Efficiency Brine Separation: Directional-freeze technology enables precise separation of brine from water, supporting a consistent throughput of 523 liters per hour. Optimized Operating Temperature: Functions reliably at 60°C, ensuring effective performance for a wide range of industrial and commercial applications. Salinity Handling: Designed to process feed water with a salinity of 4 parts per thousand, making it suitable for moderate-salinity water treatment needs. Durable Media Service Life: Offers a media service lifespan of 1,463 hours, minimizing maintenance frequency and reducing operational downtime. Electric-Powered Operation: Runs on a standard electrical energy source, supporting compatibility with most facility power systems. Custom Pricing: Unit price is determined post-acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific project requirements. Main Benefits Consistent Performance: Delivers high throughput for efficient brine separation, meeting the needs of users requiring reliable water purification or desalination. Reduced Maintenance: Extended media service life translates to fewer replacements and lower maintenance costs, addressing common user concerns about operational efficiency. User-Friendly Integration: Electric drive ensures easy installation and compatibility with existing electrical infrastructure, reducing setup complexity. Versatile Application: Capable of handling moderate salinity levels, this separator is ideal for industries such as food processing, wastewater treatment, and water recycling. Typical Use Cases or Outcomes Industrial Water Treatment: Suitable for facilities seeking to reduce brine content in process water or effluent streams. Desalination Pre-Treatment: Acts as an effective pre-treatment step in desalination plants to optimize downstream processes. Food and Beverage Processing: Supports applications where precise salt removal is essential for product quality and regulatory compliance. Sustainable Water Management: Helps organizations meet environmental standards by efficiently separating brine for responsible disposal or further processing. Frequently Addressed User Needs Is the separator durable and low-maintenance? Yes, with a 1,463-hour media service life, it minimizes the need for frequent servicing. Is it easy to install and operate? The electrically driven design ensures straightforward integration into most industrial setups. What water conditions does it handle? Optimized for feed water with up to 4 ppt salinity at 60°C, suitable for various industrial and commercial scenarios. description_html:
Key Features

  • High-Efficiency Brine Separation: Directional-freeze technology enables precise separation of brine from water, supporting a consistent throughput of 523 liters per hour.
  • Optimized Operating Temperature: Functions reliably at 60°C, ensuring effective performance for a wide range of industrial and commercial applications.
  • Salinity Handling: Designed to process feed water with a salinity of 4 parts per thousand, making it suitable for moderate-salinity water treatment needs.
  • Durable Media Service Life: Offers a media service lifespan of 1,463 hours, minimizing maintenance frequency and reducing operational downtime.
  • Electric-Powered Operation: Runs on a standard electrical energy source, supporting compatibility with most facility power systems.
  • Custom Pricing: Unit price is determined post-acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific project requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Consistent Performance: Delivers high throughput for efficient brine separation, meeting the needs of users requiring reliable water purification or desalination.
  • Reduced Maintenance: Extended media service life translates to fewer replacements and lower maintenance costs, addressing common user concerns about operational efficiency.
  • User-Friendly Integration: Electric drive ensures easy installation and compatibility with existing electrical infrastructure, reducing setup complexity.
  • Versatile Application: Capable of handling moderate salinity levels, this separator is ideal for industries such as food processing, wastewater treatment, and water recycling.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Industrial Water Treatment: Suitable for facilities seeking to reduce brine content in process water or effluent streams.
  • Desalination Pre-Treatment: Acts as an effective pre-treatment step in desalination plants to optimize downstream processes.
  • Food and Beverage Processing: Supports applications where precise salt removal is essential for product quality and regulatory compliance.
  • Sustainable Water Management: Helps organizations meet environmental standards by efficiently separating brine for responsible disposal or further processing.

Frequently Addressed User Needs

  • Is the separator durable and low-maintenance? Yes, with a 1,463-hour media service life, it minimizes the need for frequent servicing.
  • Is it easy to install and operate? The electrically driven design ensures straightforward integration into most industrial setups.
  • What water conditions does it handle? Optimized for feed water with up to 4 ppt salinity at 60°C, suitable for various industrial and commercial scenarios.

Relevant Keywords: brine separator, water treatment, directional freeze, industrial desalination, electric water separator, high-throughput, moderate salinity, low-maintenance, process water purification, sustainable water management.
